components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm-rust 44px action for creating or confirming work.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--accent); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; font:600 13px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--accent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Quiet Image Action
components.description: Bordered glass-black action that sits over a film image.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:9px; background:rgba(12,13,15,.9); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.34); cursor:pointer; font:600 13px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-quiet svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-quiet:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact search entry with subdued icon and cinema-black framing.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜索电影或导演…" aria-label="搜索电影或导演"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--bg-raised); color:var(--ink-faint); } .ds-search svg { width:17px; height:17px; flex:0 0 auto; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-search input { min-width:0; flex:1; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); font:400 14.5px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-faint); } .ds-search:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Four Action Dock
components.description: The stable primary navigation: gallery, match, projects, and saved.
components.css: .ds-dock { display:flex; width:min(100%,420px); height:58px; padding:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius:15px; background:rgba(21,22,25,.96); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.34); } .ds-dock__item { flex:1; display:flex; min-width:0; height:48px; padding:0 4px; border:0; border-radius:11px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-muted); cursor:pointer; font:550 10px/1 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-dock__item svg { width:21px; height:21px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.7; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-dock__item:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-dock__item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-dock__item:active { transform:scale(.94); } .ds-dock__item.is-active { color:var(--accent-ink); background:#29201d; }

components.name: Active Hue Filter
components.description: Measured filter state with icon, color sample, and mono hue value.
components.css: .ds-filter { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; padding:0 10px; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid rgba(196,93,62,.48); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(196,93,62,.1); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; font:600 12.5px/1 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-filter svg { width:15px; height:15px; fill:currentColor; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-filter i { width:10px; height:10px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); border-radius:3px; background:hsl(30 62% 52%); } .ds-filter code { color:currentColor; font:400 10.5px/1 ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Menlo,monospace; } .ds-filter b { font-size:12px; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color:rgba(196,93,62,.7); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-filter:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Film Frame Card
components.description: Unframed film imagery with a restrained caption gradient and color dot.
components.css: .ds-frame-card { position:relative; display:block; width:260px; aspect-ratio:16/10; padding:0; overflow:hidden; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg-raised); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; transition:transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-frame-card__image { position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#233039 0%,#6b503f 44%,#17181b 100%); } .ds-frame-card__caption { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:0; left:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; padding:26px 10px 9px; background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.72) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.32) 62%,transparent 100%); } .ds-frame-card__caption strong { overflow:hidden; color:rgba(255,255,255,.94); font:600 11.5px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.01em; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-frame-card__caption i { flex:0 0 auto; width:11px; height:11px; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius:50%; background:#b85437; box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4); } .ds-frame-card:hover { color:#fff; } .ds-frame-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-frame-card:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Saved View Switcher
components.description: Secondary two-way switch for favorites and recent history inside Saved.
components.css: .ds-saved-switcher { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:5px; width:min(100%,420px); padding:4px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg-raised); } .ds-saved-switcher button { display:flex; min-height:44px; padding:0 10px; border:0; border-radius:7px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-muted); cursor:pointer; font:600 12.5px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition:color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-saved-switcher button code { color:var(--ink-faint); font:400 9px/1 ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Menlo,monospace; } .ds-saved-switcher button:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-saved-switcher button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-saved-switcher button:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-saved-switcher button.is-active { background:var(--bg-elevated); color:var(--ink); }

components.name: Color Data Panel
components.description: Five-color palette with mono HUE, SAT, and BRI readings used across match and detail.
components.html: HUE13°SAT54%BRI72%
components.css: .ds-color-panel { width:min(100%,420px); color:var(--ink); } .ds-color-panel__palette { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); min-height:88px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:10px; } .ds-color-panel__palette button { display:flex; min-width:0; padding:7px 3px; border:0; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; background:var(--swatch); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; font:600 8px/1 ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Menlo,monospace; text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.8); transition:transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-color-panel__palette button:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-color-panel__palette button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-color-panel__palette button:active { transform:translateY(0) scale(.98); } .ds-color-panel__readings { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); margin-top:14px; } .ds-color-panel__readings span { display:flex; padding:0 12px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border-right:1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-color-panel__readings span:first-child { padding-left:0; } .ds-color-panel__readings span:last-child { padding-right:0; border-right:0; } .ds-color-panel__readings small { color:var(--ink-faint); font:400 10px/1 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-color-panel__readings strong { color:var(--ink); font:600 13px/1 ui-monospace,'SF Mono','Cascadia Code',Menlo,monospace; }

narrative.northStar: The Film Edit Bench / 电影剪辑台
narrative.overview:
“电影剪辑台”把界面理解为一张正在工作的台面：用户来这里找画面、比颜色、归项目，而不是停留在一座被动陈列的图库。CinePalette 保持成熟世界的 Operate 模式，界面负责让任务路径清晰，不为重新塑造品牌而增加新的视觉体系。

视觉重心始终落在电影截图上。近黑表面、克制暖色、紧凑控制和测量感等宽数据共同构成工作台；控件像剪辑工具一样退后，只有当前状态、关键动作和色彩读数获得强调。

从图库到识色、从详情到项目板、再从收藏回到已保存工作，四个一级入口组成稳定的生产闭环。最近浏览留在收藏内部，避免用低价值永久历史导航稀释第一视口。
keyCharacteristics: 近黑电影工作台，以细微明度层级区分结构。
暖锈与柔珊瑚只用于当前状态、关键动作和反馈。
电影截图几乎无额外框饰，标题与色点贴近画面。
色相、饱和度、亮度与 HEX 使用紧凑等宽读数。
移动端是四入口浮动 dock，桌面端从 900px 起转为 78px 左轨。

rules.name: The Active Tool Owns the Canvas Rule
rules.body: 第一视口先呈现当前工具和它的主要内容，导航保持可达但不抢夺画面。

rules.name: The Warm Accent Is a Cue Rule
rules.body: 暖色只标记当前、可执行与可保存的状态，不把内容区铺成品牌色面。

rules.name: The Image Leads, Data Measures Rule
rules.body: 影片标题和任务标题使用无衬线，色彩数值与计数才使用等宽；不要让等宽字体覆盖整段正文。

rules.name: The Four Actions Rule
rules.body: 一级导航永远保持四个高频生产动作；不要把最近浏览恢复成第五个永久入口。

rules.name: The Tonal Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: 先用影院黑、台面黑、抬升炭灰和发丝边界表达层级，阴影只证明对象确实浮在画布之上。

rules.name: The Radius Follows Function Rule
rules.body: 控件越小圆角越紧，浮层越完整圆角越大；不要把所有对象统一成胶囊或同一种圆角。

rules.name: The 44px Control Rule
rules.body: 所有高频触控动作保持至少 44px 高或 44×44px，紧凑来自排版与间距而不是缩小可点击区域。

dos: Do keep the active tool and film imagery dominant in the first viewport.
Do use near-black tonal layers and hairline borders before adding elevation.
Do reserve warm rust and coral for current state, decisive actions, and feedback.
Do keep color values, counts, angles, and percentages in measured mono typography.
Do preserve the same four primary actions when the mobile dock becomes the desktop left rail.
donts: Don't turn CinePalette into a passive gallery that stops at browsing.
Don't promote recent history into a fifth permanent navigation item.
Don't spread the warm accent across large backgrounds or decorative gradients.
Don't wrap film frames in ornamental cards, thick borders, or generic dashboard chrome.
Don't replace precise Chinese task copy and measurable color data with mood labels.
